overview.description: Scaling from a shake flask to a bioreactor is its own discipline: batch vs fed-batch, oxygen transfer and mixing limits, and the shift into GMP/quality-by-design for anything therapeutic. This is where synbio meets a P&L.
objectives: compare batch, fed-batch, and continuous processes
explain why oxygen transfer and mixing limit scale-up
monitor and control a bioreactor (pH, DO, temperature, feed)
understand GMP / quality-by-design at a high level

steps.description: Scaling from a shake flask to a bioreactor is its own discipline: batch vs fed-batch, oxygen transfer and mixing limits, and the shift into GMP/quality-by-design for anything therapeutic. This is where synbio meets a P&L.
steps.intro: Cells behave differently at 10 L than at 10 mL: gradients in oxygen, pH, and nutrients appear, so scale-up is about engineering the environment, not just growing more.
tools: process controls (pH, dissolved oxygen, feed pumps)
a QbD/GMP framework for regulated products

instructions.title: Define the process mode
instructions.description: Choose batch, fed-batch, or continuous based on product, growth, and inhibition; set the feed strategy.

instructions.title: Control the environment
instructions.description: Maintain pH, dissolved oxygen, and temperature; recognise oxygen transfer (kLa) and mixing as the usual scale-up bottlenecks.

instructions.title: Monitor & sample
instructions.description: Track growth, titer, and byproducts; keep the process in its validated window.

instructions.title: Think quality
instructions.description: For regulated products, design for GMP/QbD - critical quality attributes and process parameters defined up front.

submission.description: Propose a scale-up plan from flask to bioreactor for an expressed protein: process mode, the control parameters, and the scale-up risks (oxygen, mixing, shear).

resources.title: FDA - Quality by Design / GMP overview
